# PDF Dark

> Free online tool that converts any PDF to dark mode directly in the browser. No upload, no signup — files are processed locally via the File API and a Web Worker, so documents never leave the user's device. Read PDFs in dark mode on the spot, or download a permanently dark copy that stays dark in every reader on every device.

PDF Dark (pdfdark.org) is an independent, free web app. Unlike viewer-level dark modes (browser extensions, reader settings, OS color inversion), it rewrites the PDF file itself: dark background, light text, with photos and diagrams kept in their original colors instead of being turned into negatives. It also handles scanned PDFs.

## Tool

- [PDF Dark Mode Reader](https://pdfdark.org/): read any PDF in dark mode in the browser, free, no upload
- [Convert PDF to Dark Mode](https://pdfdark.org/converter): convert and download a permanent dark-mode copy of a PDF
